content.text: Section 22 fully satisfies the preferred position, and no other verification or remote-monitoring right binds us.

input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 meets the preferred position on every material term: audits are limited to once per twelve months (22.1), require thirty days' prior written notice, occur during normal business hours, are conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, and Vendor bears the cost unless an underpayment exceeds five percent (22.2). Direct access to Customer systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and third-party confidential information is expressly prohibited, so the walk-away concerns (unlimited/unannounced audits or remote system access) do not arise. Section 22.3 adds customer-favourable protections (findings are our Confidential Information, copy of the report, shortfall payment resolves the issue). No other verification, inspection or monitoring right binding us appears elsewhere in the Agreement. No redline required.
